notes: New in 2.3.3: your WhatsApp Agent can react to your messages. When it gets your message it puts a 👍 on it right away, so you know it arrived. You can change or turn this off in Settings → Channels → WhatsApp Agent: "React to my messages" (on or off) and "Reaction" (👍, 👀, ❤️ or ✅). The assistant can also react ❤️, 😂 or ✅ when it fits, for example ✅ when a job you asked for is done (WhatsApp keeps one reaction per message, so the ✅ replaces the 👍). It does this sparingly. If a reaction can't be sent, your answer still comes; the problem is only written to the Activity log.
